mapper.select: SELECT id, activity_id, user_id, status, contract_version, form_version, form_data, submitted_at, updated_at, cancelled_at, created_at FROM activity_registration WHERE activity_id = #{activityId} AND status IN (1, 2) AND status = #{status} ORDER BY submitted_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT id, activity_id, user_id, status, contract_version, form_version, form_data, submitted_at, updated_at, cancelled_at, created_at FROM activity_registration WHERE activity_id = #{activityId} AND status IN (1, 2) AND status = #{status} ORDER BY submitted_at DESC, id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE activity_registration SET status = 1, form_data = #{data}, submitted_at = #{now}, updated_at = #{now}, cancelled_at = NULL, contract_version = contract_version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 2
UPDATE activity_registration SET status = 2, cancelled_at = #{now}, updated_at = #{now}, contract_version = contract_version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1

UPDATE activity_registration SET status = 1, form_data = #{data}, form_version = #{formVersion}, submitted_at = #{now}, updated_at = #{now}, cancelled_at = NULL, contract_version = contract_version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 2 AND contract_version = #{version}
UPDATE activity_registration SET status = 3, invalidated_at = #{now}, invalidated_by = #{operatorId}, invalid_reason = #{reason} WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN (1, 2)
